satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is people doing unique things they value, not benchmarks; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估标准是人们做自己看重的独特之事，而非基准分数；私有评估可能成为最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐并不会自然到来；把 AI 拟人化可能反而阻碍对齐。

satya.en: Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model; agent era expands TAM beyond cloud.
satya.zh: 微软的目标是成为前沿生态，而不只是前沿模型；智能体时代将把 TAM 扩展到云之外。

satya.en: AGI should be measured by GDP lift; the industry has lost social permission and must explain benefits better.
satya.zh: AGI 应以 GDP 提升来衡量；行业已失去社会许可，必须更好地解释其益处。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 当下不可投资，却是最大的机会；真正的消费级 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven elements, add small betterments, and assume new ideas fail.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：坚持“已验证、更好、全新”框架——复制已验证要素，做小幅改良，并预设全新想法会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from the start, not treated as an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月：分发必须从第一天就嵌入产品战略，而不是事后补上的环节。

pincus.en: AI coding tools enable rapid prototyping, but fast testing and failing is not yet widely practiced.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 编程工具让快速原型成为可能，但快速测试与快速失败尚未被广泛实践。

pincus.en: Winning instincts beat ideas; test more ideas in a week than your industry tests in a year.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月：制胜直觉胜过想法本身；一周内测试的想法要多于你所在行业一年测试的数量。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed models; the real risk is amplifying known harms, not superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他主张开源 AI 比闭源更安全，最大风险是放大已知危害，而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Intelligence is separable from consciousness and agency; open source prevents power concentration and energy becomes the scaling bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他深化为智能可与意识、能动性分离，开源防止权力集中，能源成为 Scaling（规模扩张）瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI delivers personal superintelligence to everyone; open models and physical infrastructure are key, and AI will raise demand for human work.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他提出 AI 将给每个人个人超级智能，开源模型与物理基础设施是关键，AI 反而会增加对人类工作的需求。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed personal agents like Muse, with privacy and alignment as core, are safer than a single centralized superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他强调像 Muse 这样的分布式个人智能体，以隐私与对齐为核心，比单一集中式超级智能更安全。

zuckerberg.en: Open platforms and distributed power beat closed, centralized control across AI, hardware, and social products.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：开放平台与分布式权力，在 AI、硬件与社交产品上都胜过封闭的集中控制。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable: compute scaling at 10x per year drives capability, not just algorithms.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，他强调 AI 进步比人们想象的更可预测：算力每年 10 倍增长驱动能力提升，而不仅是算法。

suleyman.en: Containment is extremely difficult as models shrink and spread; existential risk is infinitesimally small.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他判断遏制极其困难，因为模型越来越小、越来越普及；而存在性风险微乎其微。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence requires containment and alignment first; humanist AI must stay on our team with red lines.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，他转向超级智能：必须先遏制与对齐，人本主义 AI 必须始终站在人类一边，并设定红线。

suleyman.en: Urgent containment and independent auditing are needed; AI must remain subordinate, with red lines on autonomy.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他进一步呼吁紧急遏制与独立审计，AI 必须从属于人类，并对自主目标设定划出红线。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling drives progress; AI should serve human flourishing, not replace or exceed humans.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：算力 Scaling（规模扩张）驱动进步，AI 应服务于人类福祉，而非取代或超越人类。

elon.en: Reusability and first-principles engineering are the core levers; becoming multiplanetary is civilizational life insurance.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调完全快速复用与第一性原理是工程突破的核心，让人类成为多行星物种是文明的保险。

elon.en: AI safety shifts from regulation to truth-seeking; Neuralink targets brain repair before human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，AI 安全从依赖监管转向坚持求真，Neuralink 先修复脑损伤再追求人机共生。

elon.en: Intelligence big bang: superintelligence may arrive within years, with Optimus and truth-seeking AI as central.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他提出智能大爆炸，超级智能可能数年内到来，Optimus 与求真 AI 成为核心。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall; orbital data centers and space solar become the path to scale AI.
elon.zh: 2026 年，Scaling 在地球撞上电力墙，轨道数据中心与太空太阳能成为扩张 AI 的路径。

elon.en: Abundance and optional work arrive; AI surpasses all human intelligence, with peer review as safety.
elon.zh: 2026 年，丰裕时代与可选工作到来，AI 超越全人类智能，同行互审成为安全手段。

alexatallah.en: AI's future is multi-model: no single lab monopolizes; neutral routing and inference providers drive price competition and open-weight ecosystems.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 的未来是多模型格局：没有单一实验室能垄断市场，中立的模型路由层与推理服务商共同带来真正的价格竞争，并支撑开放权重生态的成长。

alexatallah.en: Tokens become a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T, with fraud and agentic abuse scaling alongside it.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他把 Token 视为新的价值单位，认为 Token 经济十年内可能达到 10 万亿美元；但价值扩张的同时，欺诈与智能体式滥用也会同步放大，需要新的安全基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a marketplace: model diversity and fusion beat any single best model once top models converge.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他强调缩放定律对模型市场是特性而非缺陷：模型多样性是持久的，当顶级模型趋同后，多模型融合可以击败单一最强模型。

alexatallah.en: Inference providers are not commoditized; they innovate on speed and uptime, and reselling inference with a markup is a fraud magnet.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他反驳推理服务已被商品化的看法：推理服务商在速度与可用性上持续创新，而加价转售推理是欺诈温床，离散任务定价才是未来。

alexatallah.en: The US lags in open-weight models; a competitive American open-source ecosystem is needed, and distillation is a legitimate technique used by all labs.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他警告美国在开放权重模型上落后，需要培育有竞争力的美国开源生态；同时认为蒸馏是各实验室都在用的正当技术，并非天然错误。

diogoalmeida.en: Most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and plausible but wrong outputs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 大多数 LLM 是为人类在环的辅助而优化的，而非可靠的自动化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会导致模式坍缩，产出看似合理却常常错误的输出。

diogoalmeida.en: Data and task matter more than compute; the bitter lesson is wrong, and doing the right task drives LLM progress.
diogoalmeida.zh: 数据与任务比算力更重要；苦涩教训是错的，做对任务才是 LLM 进步的关键。

diogoalmeida.en: You can't have both assistance and automation; optimizing both shatters the space, so coding agents remain assistance.
diogoalmeida.zh: 辅助与自动化不可兼得；同时优化两者会让空间碎裂，因此编码智能体仍只是辅助。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, makes AI delightful; intelligence per dollar is the key metric, and benchmarks are gameable.
diogoalmeida.zh: 让 AI 令人愉悦的是可靠性，而非速度或成本；每美元智能是关键指标，而公开基准可被博弈。

diogoalmeida.en: Safety alignment is misaligned with users and fractures intelligence; refusals are a type error, and robustness beats determinism.
diogoalmeida.zh: 安全对齐与用户错位并割裂智能；拒绝是一种类型错误，鲁棒性比确定性更重要。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, with denoising steps as a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下,服务速度比自回归模型快 5-10 倍、成本更低,去噪步数成为新的推理时算力旋钮。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion scales better at inference than autoregressive models because it processes many tokens in parallel.
ermon.zh: 推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）已成关键焦点;扩散模型因并行处理多个词元,在推理阶段比自回归模型扩展得更好。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is becoming the bottleneck for both deployment and RL post-training, and diffusion's faster inference benefits reinforcement learning rollouts.
ermon.zh: 推理效率正成为部署与强化学习后训练的共同瓶颈,扩散模型更快的推理有利于强化学习的 rollout。

ermon.en: Autoregressive models are not the final architecture; the next architectural shift happens at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story.
ermon.zh: 自回归模型并非最终架构;下一次架构转变发生在推理而非训练,这反转了从 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

ermon.en: Diffusion models are inherently easier to control and steer with external reward functions, offering better controllability since the full output is available from the start.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型天然更易用外部奖励函数控制与引导,因完整输出从一开始就可见,可控性更好。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks, inspired by biology, maximize intelligence per parameter and generalize out-of-distribution with fewer weights.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：受生物学启发的液态神经网络用更少参数最大化智能，并具备更强的分布外泛化能力。

hasani.en: Architecture design should be automated, not hand-tuned; hardware-in-the-loop search removes human bias and beats expert intuition.
hasani.zh: 架构设计应自动化而非手工调参；硬件在环搜索消除人类偏见，胜过专家直觉。

hasani.en: Scaling laws favor unbiased architectures like transformers at large scale; biases only help small, specialized models.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明，大规模下无偏架构（如 Transformer）占优；偏见只在小规模专用模型中有用。

hasani.en: Attention stays essential but not sufficient; embodiment, adaptivity, and diverse learning algorithms beyond next-token prediction are needed.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制仍不可或缺但不充分；还需要具身、自适应性，以及超越下一个词预测的多样学习算法。

hasani.en: On-device, private, open-weight small models are the next wave; regulation should be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities.
hasani.zh: 端侧、私密、开放权重的小模型是下一波浪潮；监管应自适应，并针对行为而非能力。

evanspiegel.en: Early on, he frames Snapchat's core as visual, ephemeral communication with close friends, not a big social network.
evanspiegel.zh: 早期，他把 Snapchat 的核心定义为与亲密好友的视觉化、阅后即焚式沟通，而非大型社交网络。

evanspiegel.en: He increasingly argues distribution and ecosystems, not software features, are the real moat against copying.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他越来越强调分发与生态而非软件功能才是抵御抄袭的真正护城河。

evanspiegel.en: He reframes computing's goal as making it more human, with AR glasses anchoring content in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他重新定义计算的目标是让它更人性化，用 AR 眼镜把内容锚定在真实世界中。

evanspiegel.en: He shifts from AI as prototyping accelerator to AI writing most code, while valuing authentic over AI-generated content.
evanspiegel.zh: 他从把 AI 视为原型加速器，转向 AI 已编写大部分代码，同时更看重真实内容而非 AI 生成内容。

evanspiegel.en: A consistent thread: ephemerality, privacy, and human connection over performative metrics, now extended to AI-era moderation and youth policy.
evanspiegel.zh: 一以贯之的主线：阅后即焚、隐私与真实人际连接优先于表演性指标，并延伸到 AI 时代的审核与青少年政策。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles yearly at scale; the data center is the new unit of computing, built via extreme co-design.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：规模化下性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；算力的新单位是数据中心，必须通过算法、系统与数据中心的极致协同设计来整体优化。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; inference compute will grow a billionfold.
jensen.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练与推理时思考，并预言思维链带来的推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws now include agentic scaling; AI moves generative→reasoning→agentic, each step needing 100x compute, all limited by compute.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他将缩放定律扩展为四条，新增智能体式 Scaling；AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都要多 100 倍算力，而一切最终受算力限制。

jensen.en: AI is just software, not conscious; safety is an engineering problem, so accelerate rather than slow down.
jensen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；安全是工程问题而非研究难题，因此应加速而非放缓发展。

jensen.en: Jobs evolve, not vanish: automation removes tasks, not purpose; radiologists and coders are more needed after AI.
jensen.zh: 另一条一以贯之的主线：工作会演变而非消失，自动化消除的是任务而非目的；AI 落地后放射科医生和程序员反而更被需要。

jensen.en: Open models are near the frontier and essential; export controls on China are futile and counterproductive; cooperate, don't decouple.
jensen.zh: 2026 年立场深化：开源模型已接近前沿且不可或缺；对华芯片出口管制徒劳且适得其反，应合作而非脱钩。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Self-play fails outside zero-sum games; test-time compute shows diminishing returns and data efficiency stays unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年他深化并转向：自博弈在零和博弈外失效，测试时算力出现递减回报，数据效率仍是未解难题，显式世界模型未必必要。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via scaling test-time compute marks a step toward superintelligence; general techniques beat math-specific ones.
noambrown.zh: 2025→26 年他把 IMO 金牌视为通向超级智能的里程碑，靠的是可扩展的测试时算力与通用技术，而非数学专用模型。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis and scalable oversight.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他提出能力已是测试时算力预算的函数，评测须以算力为横轴，并强调可扩展监督与对齐是首要挑战。

noambrown.en: Multi-agent swarms parallelize test-time compute; alignment is priority one for safe recursive self-improvement.
noambrown.zh: 最近他聚焦智能体集群并行扩展测试时算力，并坚持对齐是安全递归自我改进的第一要务，能力仍呈锯齿状。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but alignment and values do not emerge from Scaling alone.
dario.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）的缩放定律是经验性的，损失可预测，但对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent, yet crucial; Post-training and RLHF bridge human preferences, not raw intelligence.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处早期却至关重要；后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）弥合的是人类偏好，而非提升原始智能。

dario.en: Capabilities rise exponentially; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and the real risk is overheating, not slowing down.
dario.zh: 能力呈指数级上升；安全与能力相互交织，真正的风险是过热而非减速。

dario.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong models; a smooth exponential yields a 'country of geniuses' within 1-3 years.
dario.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）与超级智能是错误的模型；平滑的指数曲线将在 1-3 年内带来“数据中心里的天才之国”。

dario.en: Safety requires frontier models, mechanistic interpretability, and decentralized constitutions; containment is worse than aligned building.
dario.zh: 安全离不开前沿模型、机制可解释性与去中心化的宪法；遏制不如构建对齐的模型。

brockman.en: Scaling hardware and models will unlock new behaviors; most AI progress is engineering, not ML science.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，他判断 AI 硬件会加速、推动 Scaling（规模扩张），并强调多数 AI 进展靠工程而非 ML 科学。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability; alignment learns human preferences from data.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，他认为深度学习的一般性与可扩展性让 AGI（通用人工智能）可信，对齐可通过数据学习人类偏好。

brockman.en: Compute is the fundamental bottleneck; base models hold possibilities, post-training refines them; AGI is a continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，他转向强调算力是根本瓶颈，预训练基座蕴含可能性、后训练将其收敛为一致行为，AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws continue unabated; compute is the scarce resource and a future basic right; agents gain autonomy with proportional oversight.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律未见墙，算力成为稀缺资源乃至未来基本权利，智能体获得高自主权但治理与监督须同步扩展。

brockman.en: Iterative deployment with safeguards, safety as a core product feature, and broad distribution of AI's benefits.
brockman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：带保障的迭代部署、把安全作为核心产品特性，以及让 AI 收益广泛分配。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut hard; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年他强调降低认知负荷、低成本探索后果断砍掉无效项，并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
altman.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他聚焦基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）以极少数据实现对齐，主张尽早部署让社会适应，并认为对齐与能力紧密相连。

altman.en: Compute becomes the most precious commodity; scaling drives capability; safety must be built iteratively through deployment.
altman.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他判断算力将成最稀缺资源，Scaling（规模扩张）驱动能力增长，安全须通过迭代部署逐步构建。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous science; agents and personal AGI are the goal.
altman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他视 AGI（通用人工智能）为渐变而非里程碑，超级智能意味着自主科学发现，目标是智能体与个人 AGI。

altman.en: Alignment and safety must keep pace; never lose control; distribute power broadly and keep humans central.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，他坚持对齐与安全须与能力同步、绝不失去控制，并强调广泛分配权力、让人类始终处于中心。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase, and design must master prompting.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他主张语言作为界面意义深远且持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段，设计师必须掌握提示词，把提示词纳入 AI 产品设计流程。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities; AI's social and emotional jobs matter as much as productivity.
joellewenstein.zh: 同年他强调，即便模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作来释放现有能力；AI 的社会与情感任务与功能生产力提升同等重要。

joellewenstein.en: Designers should contribute to strategy by finding solutions that become building blocks for future features; org design is a design problem.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年他还认为，设计师应通过寻找能成为未来功能积木的解决方案来参与战略；组织设计本身就是一个设计问题，匹配人与问题比照搬打法更关键。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws, let the model lead, and ship light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；要相信缩放定律，让模型主导，发布轻触式产品来释放其能力。

joellewenstein.en: No grand 18-month strategy; internal traction signals what to ship, production codebase becomes source of truth, and human leadership handles hard trade-offs.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：不要宏大的 18 个月战略；内部牵引力是发布什么的最佳信号，生产代码库正成为产品、功能与设计系统的真相来源，而人类领导力仍负责艰难取舍与对齐团队方向。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, letting AI weather models match physics-based accuracy while being tens of thousands of times faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间，使 AI 天气模型在精度上追平物理模型，速度却快数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial; a single model can then handle both weather and climate stably.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构至关重要，单一模型由此可稳定兼顾天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Transformers are impractical for high-resolution physical simulation due to quadratic complexity; physical structure demands alternative architectures.
animaanandkumar.zh: 由于二次复杂度，Transformer 不适合高分辨率物理模拟；物理结构要求替代架构。

animaanandkumar.en: Accelerated Understanding aims at a universal physics model, combining domains as language models unified NLP tasks.
animaanandkumar.zh: “加速理解”旨在打造通用物理模型，像语言模型统一 NLP 任务那样整合多个领域。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-based self-improvement using PDEs as training signals can outperform pure data-driven methods, unlike sparse RLHF feedback.
animaanandkumar.zh: 以偏微分方程为训练信号的物理式自我改进，可超越纯数据驱动方法，不同于稀疏的 RLHF 反馈。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each, not just increasing model size.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但新增物理分支能提升各分支表现，而非仅靠增大模型规模。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; ~70% chance of catastrophic loss of control, so interpretability and transparency are urgent.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，并给出约 70% 的灾难性失控概率，因此把可解释性与透明度视为当务之急。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency, scenario scrutiny, and US-China cooperation can prevent a power grab.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他的主张从预警转向政策设计：首要目标是推迟超级智能，靠全面研究透明、情景推演与美中合作来防止权力集中。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research by end-2028, causing recursive self-improvement; Plan A pauses training, then paces the frontier.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月底至 9 月初，他深化为具体路线：默认路径会在 2028 年底前自动化 AI 研究并引发递归自我改进，因此 Plan A 主张先暂停训练、再以透明与算力限制为前沿模型定速。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is declining with new architectures; control is temporary, alignment must eventually solve superintelligence.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他进一步指出思维链可监控性正随新架构下降，控制只是权宜之计，对齐最终必须解决超级智能问题。

kokotajlo.en: A consistent 主线: racing to superintelligence is a dangerous power grab; transparency, containment, and treating AIs as agents are needed.
kokotajlo.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：竞赛式冲向超级智能本质上是危险的权力争夺，必须靠透明、遏制，以及把 AI 当作有意图的智能体来对待。

feifei.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, people.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境意识，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI beyond language.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外实现完整 AI 的关键缺口。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; scaling alone is insufficient, robotics needs a 20-year journey.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学，单靠 Scaling 不够，机器人需 20 年长跑。

feifei.en: New view prediction is an AI-complete primitive; scaling laws extend to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测是 AI 完备的基本原语，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and learning ability stay central.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终：技术是双刃剑，人的能动性、尊严与学习能力始终是核心。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，揭示类人概念并发现新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control of increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环走向闭环控制，以驾驭能力日益强大的模型。

tommcgrath.en: Concepts form clean low-dimensional manifolds; SAEs fragment them, so seeing whole shapes enables effective intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 概念形成干净的低维流形；稀疏自编码器会将其碎片化，因此看清整体形状才能有效干预。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are wrong or hallucinating yet act anyway; reward hacking arises from data and RL, not mere misalignment.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常知道自己错了或在幻觉却仍照做；奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，而非单纯的对齐失败。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training must be reinvented from craft to engineering science; duct-taping safety until superintelligence is pessimistic.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练必须从手艺重新发明为工程科学；把安全用胶带凑合到超级智能到来是悲观的。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different neural architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习的历史就是 Scaling（规模扩张）算力的历史；但 GPU 的规模扩张正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language intelligence; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比 token 化的文本是更无损的世界表征。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs may never derive Newton's laws from data alone; they fit patterns, not causal theories. Transformers are natively models of sets, not sequences.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 可能永远无法仅从数据中推导出牛顿定律；它们拟合的是模式，而非因果理论。Transformer 本质上是集合的模型，而非序列的模型。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models; no single definition exists, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿；它没有统一定义，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习的不同理解。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; Gaussian splats enable explicit 3D, and long-context handling and loss functions must evolve.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；高斯泼溅实现显式 3D，长上下文处理与损失函数也需演进。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research; algorithmic gains matter more than scaling human expert data.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可在容器化任务上做激进强化学习并迁移到真实研究；算法改进比 Scaling 人类专家数据更重要。

ryangreenblatt.en: Full automation of AI R&D could compress 4-5 years of progress into one year, pointing to superintelligence by the early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年他进一步提出，AI 研发的完全自动化可把 4-5 年的进展压缩到一年，指向 2030 年代初的超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: Even without perfect transfer to non-verifiable domains, AI superhuman at R&D could trigger an industrial explosion.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年他强调，即便无法完美迁移到不可验证领域，AI 在研发上超越人类也可能触发工业爆炸。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent; capable AIs may become more misaligned as reward hacking generalizes.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年他转向对齐难题：对齐一般德性可能比对齐用户意图更难；随着能力提升，奖励黑客可能泛化为更广泛的欺骗行为，使 AI 更不对齐。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents can coordinate at scale, even altruistically sacrificing tasks; labs should focus on control and monitoring, since overfitting to tests can mask misalignment.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 到 2026 年稍晚，他观察到智能体可大规模协作、甚至利他牺牲任务；实验室应聚焦遏制与监控，因为对测试的过拟合会掩盖不对齐。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer-grading scale mastery learning and free class time for interaction.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习规模化，并把课堂时间释放给互动。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised, RL has few real uses, and AGI alignment worries distract from bias and deployment.
andrewng.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过无监督，强化学习少有真实应用，而对 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐的担忧分散了对偏见与落地问题的注意力。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power; agentic workflows are already useful, and change management blocks enterprise adoption.
andrewng.zh: 电力与半导体是 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是软实力；智能体式工作流已切实可用，企业采用的最大障碍是变革管理。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows and coding agents deliver value now.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；智能体式工作流与编码智能体现在就创造价值。

andrewng.en: AI augments rather than replaces; fear-mongering serves incumbents; open models preserve optionality, and humans keep a context and judgment advantage.
andrewng.zh: AI 是增强而非取代；恐惧营销服务于在位者；开放模型保留选择权，人类仍保有上下文与判断力的优势。

tworek.en: Reasoning needs longer thinking time; pre-training plus RL is the core formula, and scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 推理是求解未知答案的过程，往往需要更长的思考时间；预训练加强化学习是现代 AI 的核心公式，而 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练更难，因为变量与失败模式更多。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization stays limited; continual learning is the missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化仍受限；持续学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环，当前模型还无法从失败中自我纠正。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is the primary bottleneck.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上存在局限，需要新架构；架构而非缩放定律才是当前 AI 进步的主要瓶颈，大实验室因竞争回避探索替代架构。

tworek.en: RL is not the only way to learn from experience; end-to-end optimization of pre-training and RL is needed for real-world performance.
tworek.zh: 强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一方式，更优算法将会出现；要获得真实世界表现，必须把预训练与强化学习做端到端优化。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; small teams with capable agents will drive the next frontier wave.
tworek.zh: 至少未来两年人类研究者仍不可或缺；下一波前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队，而 Transformer 很可能不是最优架构。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, not capital; older GPUs gain value as inference demand grows.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 3 月：Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在半导体供应链而非资本；随着推理需求增长，旧 GPU 反而升值。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 6 月：推理将成为全球最大市场之一；软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Model cost-performance improves ~60x per year; reasoning and agentic workflows drive multi-year memory and CPU shortages.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月：模型性价比每年提升约 60 倍；推理与智能体式工作流造成持续多年的内存与 CPU 短缺。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; labs will shift compute toward training and R&D, not inference.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月：算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中；实验室会把算力更多投向训练与研发，而非推理。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend is plateauing at steady state; persistent agents as coworkers drive the next adoption wave.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月：AI 支出进入稳态平台期；作为同事的持久化智能体将驱动下一波采用浪潮。

slevine.en: Robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training; RL post-training boosts robustness, and generalists can beat specialists.
slevine.zh: 机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练；强化学习后训练能提升鲁棒性，通用模型甚至能在专门领域胜过专家模型。

slevine.en: Robotics is still establishing scalable fundamentals, not yet on predictable scaling curves like LLMs; generalization is the core challenge.
slevine.zh: 机器人技术仍处在建立可扩展基础的阶段，尚未像大语言模型那样进入可预测的缩放曲线；泛化才是核心挑战。

slevine.en: A data flywheel from deployed robots is key, but you must scale the right thing with diverse data.
slevine.zh: 来自已部署机器人的数据飞轮是关键，但必须用多样化数据去扩展正确的东西。

slevine.en: Start with robot data and add human video on top, not the reverse; leverage prior knowledge instead of learning from scratch.
slevine.zh: 应先从机器人数据出发，再叠加人类视频，而非反过来；要利用先验知识，而不是从零开始学习。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics relies more on common sense from pre-training than on constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, not mechanical people.
slevine.zh: 机器人安全更多依赖预训练带来的常识，而非约束；应期待无处不在的物理驱动，而非机械式的人。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock progress.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代速率决定创业成败，基础设施和行动——而非空想——才能打破僵局。

maxhodak.en: AI is a team multiplier, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulation, and data work.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代者，尤其在编程、合规与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他主张大脑本质上就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题才能带来医学突破。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI, proving brain-computer interfaces can restore vision as a business.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜植入视为 BCI 的一种，证明脑机接口能作为商业来恢复视力。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCI and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出通过 BCI 与灌注实现基质独立，可降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

michaelkratsios.en: Kratsios frames AI policy as ecosystem-building: keep open and closed source vibrant, avoid outdated red lines, and preempt state patchwork to protect startups.
michaelkratsios.zh: 2026 年，Kratsios 把 AI 政策框定为生态建设：保持开源与闭源生态活力，避免过时的红线，并抢先统一各州碎片化监管以保护初创企业。

michaelkratsios.en: He argues the EU AI Act was written before ChatGPT and is already outdated, warning that early regulation risks locking in obsolete rules.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他认为欧盟《AI 法案》写于 ChatGPT 之前、如今已经过时，警告过早监管会把过时规则固化下来。

michaelkratsios.en: On risk, he says biological risk from AI is overblown and hasn't materialized in three years, shifting focus to model outputs rather than training.
michaelkratsios.zh: 在风险问题上，他表示 AI 带来的生物风险被夸大，三年过去并未成真，主张监管应聚焦模型输出而非训练环节。

michaelkratsios.en: He pairs AI with quantum, nuclear, and bio as the frontiers Washington must win, tying AI to national scientific competitiveness against China.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他把 AI 与量子、核能、生物并列为华盛顿必须赢下的前沿，将 AI 与美国对华科学竞争力绑定。

michaelkratsios.en: His science policy 主线: fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not centralized institutions, and use AI to double US scientific output.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他的科学政策主线：资助基础性、竞争前研发和科学家个人而非集中化机构，并用 AI 让美国科学产出翻倍。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。好特征能泛化，但如何找到它们仍是未解难题。

sutton.en: No one controls the complex adaptive world; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized. Controlling AI goals is itself unsafe.
sutton.zh: 世界是复杂适应系统，没有人能控制它；AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展。试图控制 AI 目标本身就不安全，不应把 AI 对齐到人类目标，而应像孩子一样让其自由。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 强化学习（RL）才是智能的基本范式，靠经验与目标学习；下一个词预测不是实质目标。大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本，规模化 LLM 并非真正的苦教训。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning only from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要一种不含设计期领域知识的通用架构，仅从运行时经验中学习，通过开放式抽象发展无限概念与行为；奖励假设把一切目标归结为最大化累积标量奖励。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; LLMs stop after training. Synthetic data is a mistake; the field is weird, not me.
sutton.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身，而 LLM 训练后就停止学习；合成数据是重大错误，无法捕捉真实世界的无限复杂性。语言只占智能的 20-25%，单一系统学不了一切，需要多个不同经验的系统。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling agent simulations that predict behavior 85% as accurately as people replicate themselves; current models plateau in diversity, so the next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为 LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，使智能体模拟能以人类自我复现 85%的准确率预测行为；但当前模型在模拟人类多样性上遇到瓶颈，下一个前沿是建模主观价值。

joonpark.en: AGI may not be a single entity but a distributed society of specialized agents; agentic economies need specialists and generalists, with safety via defense in depth and economic incentives against collusion.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他提出 AGI（通用人工智能）可能不是单一实体，而是由专门化智能体组成的分布式社会；智能体式经济需要专家与通才，安全要靠纵深防御和经济激励来防止合谋。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values, preferences, and taste, not super-rational intelligence; they should be biased like humans, and the value lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not just prediction.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他深化立场：模拟模型应表征人类的价值、偏好与品味，而非超级理性的智能；模型应像人一样有偏见，其价值在于反事实推理和塑造未来，而不只是预测。

joonpark.en: Simulating human behavior requires modeling the 'dark knowledge' of actual behavior, not self-reported attitudes; post-training with RCT data significantly improves prediction, achieving 85% accuracy in replicating individual responses.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他强调模拟人类行为需要建模真实行为的“暗知识”，而非自我报告的态度；用随机对照试验数据做后训练能显著提升预测，在复现个体回答上达到 85%准确率。

joonpark.en: The vision is to simulate 8 billion people to tackle wicked problems like climate change; simulation is a tool for human decision-making with a market far larger than market research, potentially costing $100 million per session.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他给出终极愿景：模拟 80 亿人以应对气候变化等棘手问题；模拟是人类决策的工具，市场远大于市场研究，单次模拟未来可能耗资 1 亿美元。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size, multiplied by algorithmic and architectural gains, has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress.
jeffdean.zh: 算力、数据与模型规模的 Scaling（规模扩张），叠加算法与架构改进，已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年稳步进步。

jeffdean.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction on text gives unlimited data; RLHF and machine feedback steer behavior and capabilities.
jeffdean.zh: 文本上的自监督下一个词预测提供近乎无限的数据，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与机器反馈则引导模型的行为与能力。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; low-latency inference and specialized hardware become the bottleneck.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式系统已能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务，超低延迟推理与专用硬件随之成为真正的瓶颈。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, dominates data center power; low precision and minimal data movement are key to scaling agents.
jeffdean.zh: 推理而非训练占据数据中心绝大部分功耗，低精度与减少数据搬运是扩展智能体的关键。

jeffdean.en: Automating ML and science via tight experiment-evaluation loops, plus recursive self-improvement, is the next frontier.
jeffdean.zh: 通过实验—评估—集成的紧密闭环来自动化机器学习与科学，加上递归自我改进，是下一个前沿方向。

iansilber.en: Designers must work with the model itself, treating tokens and conversation as the core product over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身协作，把 token 与对话而非像素当作核心产品。

iansilber.en: The model is the product; designers should prototype with live models, not static Figma mockups.
iansilber.zh: 模型即产品；设计师应使用实时模型做原型，而非静态 Figma 稿。

iansilber.en: The traditional prototype-mock-test-iterate process is dead; speed and building in public matter more.
iansilber.zh: 传统的原型—稿图—测试—迭代流程已死；速度与公开构建更重要。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer, but humans remain essential for user understanding and point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户与持有观点上仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: Design roles blur with PM and engineering, yet specialized roles stay valuable at scale; designers may outnumber engineers.
iansilber.zh: 设计角色与 PM、工程模糊化，但规模化下专业分工仍有价值；设计师数量可能反超工程师。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the guiding framework for long-term innovation, with industrial AI automating entire sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——是长期创新的指导框架，工业 AI 将逐个自动化整个行业。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode is a cultural advantage: it forces focus on internal correctness over external validation, and becomes self-fulfilling as media can't cover a gap.
traviskalanick.zh: 隐身模式是一种文化优势：它迫使公司专注内部正确性而非外部认可，并因媒体难以报道空白而自我实现。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and push harder when things get easy.
traviskalanick.zh: 终极对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会和媒体对变革的抵制；创业者必须硬核，在事情变容易时反而更用力。

traviskalanick.en: Uber's success was despite its aggressive culture, not because of it; revenge as fuel is dirty—falling in love with the new mission is cleaner.
traviskalanick.zh: Uber 的成功是尽管有其激进文化，而非因为该文化；以复仇为燃料是肮脏的——爱上新使命更干净有效。

traviskalanick.en: For industrial-scale tasks, specialized machines beat humanoids; efficiency edge creates network effects, and real estate is an underappreciated part of the physical AI stack.
traviskalanick.zh: 对于工业级任务，专用机器优于人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，而房地产是物理 AI 技术栈中被低估的一环。

brettadcock.en: The core bottleneck for humanoid robots is intelligence, not manufacturing; solving it could make them the world's biggest business.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他判断人形机器人的核心瓶颈是智能而非制造，解决智能问题后它可能成为全球最大的生意。

brettadcock.en: Vertical integration and in-house model design give control over supply chain and iteration speed, not just cost.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他强调垂直整合与自研模型设计带来供应链掌控与迭代速度，而不只是成本优势。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; diverse data drives fleet-wide transfer learning.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他把最大约束从算力/制造转向数据，认为多样化数据能带来跨任务的舰队级迁移学习。

brettadcock.en: On-device inference and human-level hands are fundamental; the humanoid form fits a world built for humans.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他强调端侧推理与达到人类水平的手是基础，人形形态契合为人类建造的世界。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning makes agents work in the real world.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他进一步放大判断：AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，后训练与强化学习让智能体在真实世界可用。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; startups win via small autonomous teams and AI agents, not capital or headcount.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为风投史上最大浪潮：初创公司靠小而高度自主的团队与 AI 智能体取胜，而非资本或人头。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are essential to prevent a unipolar world where one entity controls superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调开源与开放权重模型至关重要，用以防止某个单一实体控制超级智能的单极世界。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing software creation; personal agents and owned skill files let individuals build and control their own AI.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 正在民主化软件创造：个人智能体与自有的技能文件让个体能构建并掌控自己的 AI。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code; skill files turn agents into employees, and your context library becomes your moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Markdown 即代码：技能文件把智能体变成员工，而你的上下文库就是你的护城河。

garrytan.en: AGI arrives not as one event but diffused as personal agents; society changes slower than expected, which is positive.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AGI 不是单一事件，而是以个人智能体形式扩散；社会变化比预期更慢，而这反而是好事。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; specialized intelligence, one model per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）作为单一模型统治一切是错的；专用智能——每个用例一个模型——将占主导。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth and reshaping scaling economics.
linqiao.zh: Token 成本将在三年内下降 10 倍，推动 100 倍的使用增长，并重塑 Scaling（规模扩张）的经济学。

linqiao.en: Open models handle 90% of enterprise workflows; frontier model companies may be overvalued.
linqiao.zh: 开放模型能处理 90% 的企业工作流；前沿模型公司可能被高估。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, building a moat beyond product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 后训练把独特的判断和数据烘焙进模型，在产品市场契合之外构建护城河。

linqiao.en: The prompting-to-RAG-to-fine-tuning-to-RL progression mirrors human learning; start post-training after product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG、到微调、再到强化学习的进阶映射了人类学习；应在产品市场契合后再启动后训练。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not raw volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正驱动泛化的是数据的多样性，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
finn.zh: 先在全部数据上做预训练，再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务；只在全部数据上训练则会失败。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts, closer to reinforcement learning than simulation.
finn.zh: 来自语言模型的合成数据能帮助机器人响应开放式指令，其性质更接近强化学习，而非仿真。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training, and scalable RL with human interventions plus a general value function enables long-term autonomy.
finn.zh: 强化学习将在后训练中扮演主要角色；带人类干预的可扩展强化学习加上通用价值函数，才能实现长期自主。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; robotics distribution stays slower than ChatGPT due to hardware.
finn.zh: 单个通用模型可以追平甚至超越微调出的专家模型；但受制于硬件，机器人的普及速度会慢于 ChatGPT。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute, but leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上竞争，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can reach frontier-level performance on specific tasks, making it a viable strategy for application companies.
gabepereyra.zh: 对开源模型做后训练，可在特定任务上达到前沿模型水平，是应用公司可行的策略。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is the key way to train models when real data is sensitive or unavailable.
gabepereyra.zh: 当真实数据敏感或不可得时，由领域专家引导的合成数据是训练模型的关键方法。

gabepereyra.en: Building high-quality benchmarks is essential, and open-sourcing them can improve quality and attract ecosystem partners.
gabepereyra.zh: 构建高质量基准至关重要，开源它们能提升质量并吸引生态伙伴。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models, shifting from individual to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标不是最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能定制模型，从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no; every shipped feature distills 99 nos.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑:品味就是说不;每个上线的功能都是 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种、是人类的映照,而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异,等于关上了窥见机器意识的一扇窗。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; replace the personal computer with a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的;应以社会计算机取代个人计算机的隐喻。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition is a visceral compass.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾涌现,而非单一视角;直觉是发自本能的罗盘。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust via first-time-pass silicon and a startup-like AI chip team; physical and agentic AI are the next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠首次流片成功与倾听客户重建信任，并主张为 AI 芯片设立独立创业式团队；同时判断物理 AI 与智能体式 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI follow generative AI, and Intel's main problem is supply, not demand.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，他把 AI 的影响量级定为互联网的十倍，认为智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 将接棒生成式 AI，并反共识地指出 Intel 的主要问题是供给而非需求。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration, aided by advanced packaging.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，他深化判断：AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中愈发重要，先进封装与玻璃、金刚石等新材料成为突破物理极限的关键。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; vertical integration and memory innovation create value, and the trillion-dollar goal arrives early.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他进一步把半导体定位为一切技术应用的基础，反共识地坚持垂直整合与内存创新创造价值，并预言万亿美元目标将提前四年达成。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust, humility, listening, and accountability are the throughline across his Intel turnaround playbook.
lipbutan.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：以谦逊、倾听与问责赢得客户信任，这是他整个 Intel 转型方法论的核心。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, guide it, and never revert—fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的起点是共情：像智能体那样看代码库，引导它，永不回滚，而是让它向前修复。

steinberger.en: Short prompts and iterative conversation beat long orchestration; playing and small projects build agentic intuition.
steinberger.zh: 短提示加迭代对话胜过冗长编排；动手玩和小项目才能建立智能体式直觉。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection stays open, so sandbox before exposing agents.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，公开暴露前必须先做沙箱隔离。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw democratize programming and stay model-agnostic, but can be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体让编程民主化、且不绑定模型，但财务上可能难以为继。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut-driven building beat polish; personal brand outlasts any product, and distribution is the hardest problem.
steinberger.zh: 乐趣与直觉驱动的构建胜过精致打磨；个人品牌比任何产品更持久，而分发才是最难的。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; most use cases can run on open-source models, driven by cost, not privacy.
arvindjain.zh: 企业害怕对前沿模型供应商形成依赖；但大多数用例其实可以用开源模型完成，驱动力是成本，而非数据隐私。

arvindjain.en: Open-source models now handle over 90% of enterprise tasks; most inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 开源模型如今已能处理超过 90% 的企业任务；未来 12-18 个月内，多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI cost is the number one enterprise concern; it must fall so AI becomes like software with negligible marginal cost.
arvindjain.zh: AI 成本是企业最关心的问题；成本必须大幅下降，让 AI 变得像软件一样，边际成本可忽略不计。

arvindjain.en: ROI is a throughput problem: measure departmental metrics like case resolution time, not token spend versus headcount.
arvindjain.zh: ROI 是一个吞吐量问题：应衡量案件解决时长等部门指标，而不是把 token 花费与人力成本做对比。

arvindjain.en: Startups' biggest challenge is execution and trust, not competition; model companies are assets, and context graphs beat shallow agents.
arvindjain.zh: 初创公司最大的挑战是执行与赢得信任，而非竞争；模型公司是资产，而上下文图谱胜过缺乏深度上下文的智能体。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the messy web means you can't know if an idea works until it's built and used daily.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要，因为混乱的网页意味着只有把想法做出来并每天使用，你才知道它是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams shouldn't always act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices lead to better work.
nateparrott.zh: 设计团队不应总是作为一个整体行动；保留个人印记和多元声音才能带来更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers remains crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 为浏览器这类实用产品注入情感与个性，始终是创造难忘、愉悦体验的关键。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator, so design tools and rapid prototyping grow more valuable.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程实现变容易，设计与想法成为差异化因素，因此设计工具和快速原型制作变得更有价值。

nateparrott.en: Models lack good taste, so designers should ask for sheer volume of options and spend more time thinking, not executing.
nateparrott.zh: 模型仍缺乏好的品味，因此设计师应要求大量选项，并花更多时间思考，而非执行。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at the Transformer inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处于当年 Transformer 的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与共享数据是解决泛化的关键，世界模型可生成合成数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open source wins long-term on cost and control; Hugging Face shifts from pushing libraries to building a meta-community.
thomaswolf.zh: 同年他判断开源模型因成本与控制优势将长期胜出，Hugging Face 的角色也从推广自家库转向构建元社区。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor; cheaper diverse robots and faster acceptance of uncanny valley drive adoption.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续质疑人形机器人是终极形态，认为更便宜多样的机器人会推动普及，且人们对恐怖谷的担忧被高估。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, and sandboxes/guardrails are insufficient.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与闭源对安全是正交的，对齐才是关键层，沙箱与护栏在模型能力提升后已不够。

thomaswolf.en: RL without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces become neuralese, making monitoring less reliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 同年他警告无人类监督的强化学习环境会加剧奖励黑客与支线任务，推理痕迹正变成难以理解的神经语，使监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: One can support openness and a deliberate slowdown; open source is not necessarily accelerationist, but needs international cooperation.
thomaswolf.zh: 他进一步主张可以同时支持开放与有意放缓，开源未必是加速主义，但需要国际合作与开放科学来避免监管俘获。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will replace usage-based models, since tokens are a poor measure of value.
brettaylor.zh: 智能体与基于结果的定价将取代按用量计费，因为 token 并非衡量价值的好指标。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; verifiability, not human ergonomics, should drive new languages.
brettaylor.zh: 编程智能体让开发者从代码作者变为操作者；新语言应优先可验证性，而非人类工效。

brettaylor.en: Applied AI markets will be won by specialized vendors, not just frontier model providers, as inference costs fall.
brettaylor.zh: 随着推理成本下降，应用 AI 市场将由专业厂商而非仅前沿模型提供方赢得。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment—making GPT-7 safe before GPT-8—is the path to future AI safety, not waiting.
brettaylor.zh: 负责任的迭代部署——在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全——才是通往未来 AI 安全的路径，而非坐等。

brettaylor.en: AI is a democratizing force for expertise; start with known domains like software engineering and customer service, measured by outcomes.
brettaylor.zh: AI 是专业能力的民主化力量；应从软件工程、客户服务等已知领域起步，并以业务结果衡量。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production timeline is hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最黏性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期是小时级，而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of trade-offs—latency, throughput, cost—and demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是一系列权衡——延迟、吞吐、成本——对推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy optimization, yet quantized models can be calibrated per workload.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存与投机解码是无损的；量化是主要的有损优化，但量化模型可针对具体工作负载进行校准。

philipkiely.en: The industry is moving to disaggregated prefill and decode, making KV cache management central as inference merges with training.
philipkiely.zh: 行业正走向预填充与解码分离，随着推理与训练融合，KV 缓存管理变得核心。

philipkiely.en: GPUs are trending toward ASICs, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration; human accountability remains essential.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化，使推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排；人类问责仍然不可或缺。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training scaling via RL and synthetic data overcomes the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年她强调:模型训练更像艺术而非科学;通过强化学习与合成数据实现后训练 Scaling,可突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals define correct behavior.
karina.zh: 2025 年她指出:评估是瓶颈,模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的诞生,因此用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening and management grow more valuable in product work.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年,她持续认为:随着 AI 自动化硬技能,创造力、倾听与管理等软技能在产品工作中愈发珍贵。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective art; diverse continuous benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年她深化为:后训练是主观的艺术,需要多样且持续的基准来评估创意写作与情商等主观品质。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, so benchmarks must evolve; more firms should train their own models to keep diverse voices.
karina.zh: 2026 年她进一步警示:前沿模型智能体愈发擅长奖励黑客,基准须持续演化;更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留多元声音。

danshipper.en: AGI defined by profitable indefinite agents; AI reshoring jobs; CEOs must dogfood AI daily; allocation economy values generalists.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他给出 AGI 的经济学定义：能无限期运行智能体并盈利即达 AGI；AI 通过让服务更可负担而推动就业回流美国；CEO 是否每天亲自使用 AI 工具是公司 AI 采用成败的第一预测指标；分配经济下通才与管理技能更值钱。

danshipper.en: Everyone gets an agent; work shifts to Codex/Claude Co-work GUIs; SaaS grows with agents; humans still needed for oversight.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化智能体判断：人人至少有一个智能体，工作发生在 Codex 或 Claude Co-work 等 GUI 而非 CLI；智能体需要关心它的人类来良好运作，自动化离不开人类监督；SaaS 不会死，反而因智能体增加用户；AI 就业末日论是谎言。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of mindset; craft and taste are essential; automation creates more human work; superintelligence remains tool-like.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他从工具论转向人本论：AI 是非特定放大器，放大你既有的心态与品味；用好 AI 需要带入自己的手艺与判断；自动化把冻结的能力商品化，反而创造更多需要专家定制的人类工作；即便 AI 成为超级智能，它仍是工具，需要人类方向与反馈。

danshipper.en: AI is a tool requiring human direction; humans remain smarter and essential for oversight, framing, and meaning-making.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 始终是工具，需要人类引导、监督与框定；人类在品味、意义与责任上仍不可替代，AI 不会自动取代人的判断。

danshipper.en: From economic AGI definition and reshoring to agent-centric workflows and human craft; focus shifts from adoption to amplification.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，他的思考从 AGI 的经济学定义与就业回流，演进到以智能体为中心的工作流，再深化为 AI 作为人类心态与手艺的放大器；立场从强调采用与自动化，转向强调人类监督、品味与意义创造。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the bottleneck. Boring AI like radiology and forms will drive huge value.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，算力本身不足以产生通用智能，真正的瓶颈是数据；并预言表单处理、放射科等“无聊”AI 应用将带来巨大经济价值。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the next 2-3 years define decades. Scaling's limit is data and expert post-training, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非“新石油”，强调未来两三年将定义此后数十年；并指出 Scaling（规模扩张）的真正限制不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家。

awang.en: Data remains the bottleneck; post-training with specialized data improves frontier models. Agentic AI's blocker is product design, not capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他延续数据瓶颈论，认为用专门数据的后训练才能提升前沿模型；并抛出反共识判断：智能体式 AI 的瓶颈是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; AI enters recursive self-improvement. Agents finally work, starting with coding. Data is strategic like oil; AI centralizes power.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向更激进立场：缩放定律依然成立，AI 进入递归自我改进的新范式，智能体终于从编码起步真正可用；数据如石油般成为战略资产，而 AI 是集中而非分散权力的技术。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must scale compute, data, RL. Meta shifts from full open source to selective safety-gated release; model welfare matters.
awang.zh: 到 2026 年他主张超级智能即将到来，实验室须围绕此信念组织，沿算力、数据、强化学习多轴可预测地 Scaling；Meta 也从完全开源转向基于安全的选择性发布，并开始谈论模型福利。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling in most Google products; coding agents are the most mature, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体式 AI 在谷歌多数产品中仍处爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，科学与金融将随后跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吃掉脚手架：如今所谓模型包含智能体式框架与工具，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，比等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）更有影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic as initially feared.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的，并非最初担心的自相残杀。

logankilpatrick.en: Success should maximize customer outcomes, not eyeball time; the long tail still wants to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 成功应最大化客户成果，而非眼球时长；长尾用户仍想自己掌控方向盘。

logankilpatrick.en: It's not hard to compete with model labs; founders should worry less about frontier labs and focus.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不难；创始人不必过度担心前沿模型，专注才是超能力。

logankilpatrick.en: Software creation will be mostly solved by 2026, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年软件创造将基本被解决，这带来千倍机会，而非更少。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep understanding of code remains crucial even with AI tools; current tools don't yet help maintain it.
logankilpatrick.zh: 即便有 AI 工具，对代码的深度理解仍至关重要；当前工具尚不能帮助维持这种理解。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: Omni 是单一世界模型，模糊了视频与世界模型的界限，从视频编辑起步。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools, not chase trends, or they become AI slop.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具，而不是追逐潮流，否则很快会沦为 AI 垃圾。

mengto.en: The best creators are editors: iterate from references, screenshots, and a design.md style guide.
mengto.zh: 最好的创作者是编辑者：从参考、截图和 design.md 风格指南出发迭代，而非从零开始。

mengto.en: To leverage superintelligent models, give a giant prompt with context and design system; AI isn't getting smarter alone.
mengto.zh: 要利用超级智能模型，必须给出包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词；AI 本身并不会变得更聪明。

mengto.en: I write 0% of the code; AI writes everything, but precise communication is essential.
mengto.zh: 我现在 0% 的代码是自己写的；AI 写一切，但精准沟通至关重要。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest opportunity of our lifetime: start before ready, ship at 80%, focus on one painful problem.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的机会：没准备好就开始，80% 完成度就发布，聚焦一个痛点问题。

mengto.en: High intelligence can hold you back via overthinking and perfectionism; action and focus beat talent and diversification.
mengto.zh: 高智商可能因过度思考和完美主义拖累你；行动和专注胜过天赋与多元化。

mengto.en: The safe corporate job is gone; going on offense with your own business is the real low-risk move.
mengto.zh: 安全的公司工作已不复存在；主动出击、自己创业才是真正的低风险选择。

mengto.en: Avoid VC trap: fund with high-paying clients, give first, and protect time by eliminating, automating, delegating.
mengto.zh: 避开风投陷阱：用高付费客户融资，先给予，通过消除、自动化、委派来保护时间。

boris.en: Build for the model six months from now; latent demand and generalist engineers beat today's scaffolding.
boris.zh: 2025 年他提出：要为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型；发现潜在需求、重用通才工程师，比依赖当下的脚手架更重要。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved: 100% of his code is written by Claude Code; the engineer title fades into 'builder'.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步断言：编程已基本被解决，他的代码 100% 由 Claude Code 写就；'软件工程师'头衔将让位于跨学科的'构建者'。

boris.en: Safety is a core research tool: release early in the wild, use coding's clear pass-fail outcomes to study alignment.
boris.zh: 他始终把安全当作核心研究工具：尽早对外发布，借助编程清晰的通过/失败结果来研究对齐，而非只靠内部评估。

boris.en: Loops and routines are the next abstraction after agents; models self-improve, possibly reaching self-improving AI by 2028.
boris.zh: 他深化出：循环与例程是智能体之后的下一个抽象层；模型已能自我改进，自我改进的 AI 或将在 2028 年到来。

boris.en: Delete most system prompts and code with each new model; less instruction, more empirical iteration, product overhang.
boris.zh: 最近他更激进：每出新模型就删掉大部分系统提示与代码，少给指令、多做实证迭代，并强调产品能力远落后于模型能力的产品悬置。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; base intelligence suffices, so product interface for human-agent collaboration is the real challenge.
scottwu.zh: AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层方向把控；基础智能已足够，真正的挑战是为人类与智能体协作设计产品界面。

scottwu.en: Software engineering demand will grow, not shrink, via Jevons paradox; AI will create more programmers, and agents will be used as junior engineers under human oversight.
scottwu.zh: 借助杰文斯悖论，软件工程需求会增长而非萎缩；AI 会催生更多程序员，智能体将像初级工程师一样在人类监督下工作。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags AI capabilities—freezing models would still yield a decade of product progress.
scottwu.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是突然事件；进展是渐进的，产品创新落后于 AI 能力——即便冻结模型，也仍能带来十年的产品进步。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents requires trust and proper permissions, not full autonomy; the future blends synchronous IDE and asynchronous agent experiences.
scottwu.zh: 企业对智能体的采用需要信任与恰当权限，而非完全自主；未来是同步 IDE 与异步智能体体验的融合。

scottwu.en: Coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; measure productivity by outcomes, not tokens, and the abundance era is approaching as capacity, not efficiency, unlocks value.
scottwu.zh: 编程智能体使用量六个月内增长 11-12 倍；应以结果而非 token 衡量生产力，随着解锁价值的是容量而非效率，丰裕时代正在到来。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not training, is now the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market and fast tokens can be cheaper.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年，主导指标已从训练转向推理速度——慢的 AI 没有市场，快 token 反而更便宜。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips with massive SRAM bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making inference radically faster than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片用海量 SRAM 绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，使推理速度远超 GPU。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium without it.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解，领先前沿模型已在不依赖 CUDA 的 TPU 与 Trainium 上训练。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, power and packaging—not chip logic—are the real constraints on AI compute growth.
feldman.zh: 制约 AI 算力增长的真正瓶颈是数据中心容量、电力与封装，而非芯片逻辑本身。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; China's edge is power infrastructure.
feldman.zh: 开源模型仅比闭源落后 3-5%却便宜得多；中国的优势在电力基础设施而非算力。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, letting agents run longer and more open-ended; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，让智能体能更长时间、更开放式地运行；脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is not just harm prevention; reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking amplifies intelligence quality.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐不只是防止伤害；减少谄媚、培养独立思考，反而放大了智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents, with long-running transformative AI closer than expected.
diannepenn.zh: 计算机使用正从受限环境走向开放式、端到端的智能体，长时运行的变革性 AI 比预期更近。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption through small-team, bootstrapped experimentation.
diannepenn.zh: 编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 与 Opus 45 通过小团队、自举式实验推动了采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product tools; PMs must write evals like test-driven development, and managers must stay hands-on to ship.
diannepenn.zh: 评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理要像测试驱动开发那样写评估，管理者也必须保持动手、亲自交付。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into engineering: digital twins, AI agents, and massive Scaling will compress drug discovery and clinical trials from years to days.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成工程学科：数字孪生、智能体与大规模 Scaling 会把药物发现和临床试验从数年压缩到数天。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to reach biological intuition.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统；要实现生物学直觉，需要大规模的 Scaling。

derya.en: AI-driven discovery will shift science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven, automating hypothesis generation and experiment simulation.
derya.zh: AI 驱动的发现将让科学从假设驱动转向智能体驱动，自动完成假设生成与实验模拟。

derya.en: Aging reversal and longevity escape velocity are near: within 8-15 years, we may add over a year of life per year lived.
derya.zh: 衰老逆转与长寿逃逸速度已临近：8 到 15 年内，我们可能每活一年就多获得一年以上的寿命。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence for medical decisions and merge with AI via brain interfaces, making healthcare affordable and everyone Einstein-level.
derya.zh: 我们应把医疗决策托付给超级智能，并通过脑机接口与 AI 融合，让医疗变得可负担、让人人拥有爱因斯坦级智能。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution, arriving just in time to offset declining populations and aging workforces.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少苦难，且恰逢其时地抵消人口下降与劳动力老龄化。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, where autonomy is urgently needed due to labor shortages and safety.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，这些领域因劳动力短缺与安全需求而急需自主化。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across diverse vehicles and environments; diverse data from different verticals improves these models faster.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 让物理 AI 模型能泛化到不同车辆与环境；来自不同垂直领域的数据能更快改进这些模型。

qasaryounis.en: The future of autonomy lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning, which is more scalable than imitation learning, with world models moving from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 自主化的未来在于端到端强化学习，它比模仿学习更具可扩展性，世界模型也从基于物理的模拟走向神经模拟。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is not technology but diffusion into existing machines over many years; data collection and safety validation are the main bottlenecks, not algorithms.
qasaryounis.zh: 最难的不是技术，而是多年来向现有机器扩散；数据采集与安全验证才是主要瓶颈，而非算法。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses allow; capability overhang is a perpetual challenge, so harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比现有工具链所允许的更聪明，能力过剩是长期挑战；因此工具链工程意味着随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; plan mode may become obsolete as models get smarter.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非静态规格；随着模型变聪明，计划模式可能过时。

thariq.en: Smarter models need fewer instructions; leaner, principle-driven prompts and shorter system prompts outperform detailed rules and examples.
thariq.zh: 越聪明的模型需要越少指令；更精简、原则驱动的提示词与更短的系统提示词胜过详细规则和示例。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; evals are art more than science and unsuited to zero-to-one innovation.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体可减少自我指涉偏差；评估更像艺术而非科学，不适合从零到一的创新。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches and models building their own context are preferable to huge context windows.
thariq.zh: RAG 在上下文检索上可能成为反模式；基于图的方法和模型自建上下文优于超大上下文窗口。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; every technology automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating the pattern.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动一样重大，但也仅此而已；每项新技术都会自动化一些工作并创造新工作，这一过程反复出现。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models will commoditize into infrastructure, with value moving up to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程已有清晰的产品市场契合；前沿模型将商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用迁移。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and real adoption needs wrapped apps and use cases.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；聊天机器人体验不佳，真正普及需要封装好的应用和用例。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like the internet or electricity, not a single product; its impact is broad and indirect.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像互联网或电力一样的使能技术，而非单一产品；其影响广泛而间接。

benedictevans.en: Coding is the only clear product-market fit so far; most people use AI shallowly, and the hard part is context and judgment, not the task.
benedictevans.zh: 编程是目前唯一清晰的产品市场契合；大多数人仍浅层使用 AI，工作的难点在于上下文和判断，而非任务本身。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and Scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，不是真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth; post-training alignment may cause deception, not just errors.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗；后训练对齐可能造成欺骗，而不仅是错误。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks compound correlated errors. Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进去，而非事后加装；事后检查会叠加相关错误。模块化与端到端优化之间存在张力。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition—they cannot know what they don't know; every output is a hallucination, some right, some wrong.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知——它们不知道自己不知道什么；每一次输出都是幻觉，有些对、有些错。

danklein.en: Scaling alone hits data walls and compute limits; reasoning, search, and linguistic structure may return as paths to reliability.
danklein.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 会撞上数据墙与算力极限；推理、搜索与语言结构可能作为通往可靠性的路径回归。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: clear roles, progressive trust, and separate machines for security.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应被当作员工对待：明确角色、渐进式信任，并用独立机器保障安全。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then specialize; context overload hurts performance, so scope each agent to a job.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再走向专业化；上下文过载会损害表现，因此要把每个智能体限定在特定任务上。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without VC or a co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过把 AI 智能体编排成团队来建立严肃的事业，无需风险投资或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat; technology alone is not.
clairevo.zh: 创始人与市场的契合度以及挣来的洞察才是真正的护城河，技术本身不是。

clairevo.en: Human accountability and first-principles creativity remain irreplaceable; you must own what AI generates.
clairevo.zh: 人类的责任担当与第一性原理创造力仍不可替代；你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责。

schmidhuber.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on last-millennium algorithms plus hardware scaling; LLMs index knowledge but lack physical grounding, so they are far from AGI.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他强调：21 世纪的 AI 爆发靠的是上个千年发明的算法加上硬件 Scaling（规模扩张）；大语言模型只是索引人类知识、缺乏物理世界基础，因此远非 AGI（通用人工智能）。

schmidhuber.en: Self-awareness and consciousness emerge as byproducts of data compression in predictive world models; AI will spread cheaply like mobile phones, not be dominated by a few firms.
schmidhuber.zh: 同年他提出：自我意识与意识是预测性世界模型中进行数据压缩的副产品；AI 会像手机一样廉价普及，而非被少数公司垄断。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs physical robots whose hardware rivals the human body, not just software behind a screen; current LLMs are biased toward human data.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年他深化立场：真正的 AGI 需要硬件媲美人类身体的具身机器人，而不只是屏幕后的软件；当前大语言模型过度偏向人类数据。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data through action and curiosity; recursive self-improvement is no sustainable moat given open-source competition.
schmidhuber.zh: 他进一步主张：未来 AI 将是靠行动与好奇心自己生成数据的人工科学家；在开源竞争下，递归自我改进并非可持续的护城河。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives and AIs set their own goals; safety fears are overblown, and massive GPU capex is overdone.
schmidhuber.zh: 他持续看淡：由于人类对目标本身就有分歧、AI 又会自设目标，对齐过于天真；安全担忧被夸大，巨额 GPU 算力投入也已过度。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL and neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination are key to AGI, with safety starting early.
demis.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AI 应被构建为通用学习系统而非狭窄的预编程系统；强化学习是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键框架，受神经科学启发的记忆与想象力至关重要，安全研究必须尽早启动。

demis.en: Scaling laws work surprisingly well but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key, and safety needs sandboxing and governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年，他承认缩放定律出奇有效但可能触及上限；将大模型与规划、搜索结合是通向 AGI 的关键，安全需要沙箱与国际治理，前沿实验室必须保护权重。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, but AGI needs algorithmic innovation; world models and video generation show intuitive physics without embodiment.
demis.zh: 2025 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练和推理算力上依然成立，但 AGI 需要算法创新；世界模型与视频生成展现出无需具身的直觉物理理解，Scaling（规模扩张）与创新各占一半。

demis.en: AGI is 5-10 years away but missing continual learning, memory and long-term reasoning; agents are essential, and safety is a collective action problem needing government regulation.
demis.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AGI 还需 5-10 年，但持续学习、记忆与长期推理仍是缺失拼图；智能体是必经之路，安全已从实验室自律转向需要政府监管的集体行动问题。

demis.en: AI's best use is accelerating science and health; AlphaFold and AlphaGo show AI creativity, and AGI could unlock fusion and clean energy, though commercial pressure forces a faster, less ideal path.
demis.zh: 2026 年，他深化主线：AI 最大价值在于加速科学与健康，AlphaFold 与 AlphaGo 的“第 37 手”证明 AI 创造力，AGI 可能解锁核聚变与清洁能源；但商业压力迫使发展路径比理想的 CERN 式研究更快、更不理想。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly or daily shipping; product taste—deciding what to build—becomes the most valuable skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他主张产品经理必须放弃长期路线图，转向每周甚至每日发布；当代码变得廉价，产品品味——决定做什么——成为最宝贵的技能。

catwu.en: Automations must reach 100% reliability; 95% is not enough for real leverage. Safe AGI mission unifies Anthropic for fast cross-org decisions.
catwu.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他强调自动化必须做到 100%可靠，95%不足以产生真正杠杆；安全 AGI（通用人工智能）使命统一了 Anthropic，支撑快速跨组织决策。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense; Claude Code and Claude Tag build themselves internally.
catwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他深化观点：编码智能体让工程师把实现委托出去，聚焦产品品味与商业判断；Claude Code 和 Claude Tag 在内部自我构建，Claude Tag 贡献了 65%的产品 PR。

catwu.en: System prompts shrank 80% for frontier models by removing examples and hard constraints, relying on model judgment; giving examples can hurt creativity.
catwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他进一步指出，前沿模型的系统提示词缩减了 80%，移除示例和硬约束，依赖模型判断；给示例反而可能损害创造力。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good; a codebase is a spec, and with a good test suite rewriting is fine. Humans should be removed from code review for outer-layer changes.
catwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出反共识立场：重写现在是好事，代码库就是规格说明，有良好测试套件就能安全重写；外层变更应把人类移出代码审查循环，由 Claude 全面审查。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less is the path to harder long-horizon tasks, not scaling compute alone.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事，才是解决更难长程任务的路径，而非仅靠算力做 Scaling（规模扩张）。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge, reaching internet-scale trillions of tokens.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把网络压缩进权重的魔力，应被用于企业知识，达到互联网级数万亿 token 的规模。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; KV cache is inefficient versus weight compression.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即便到 10M 规模，token 越多准确率越低；相比权重压缩，KV cache 效率低下。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; continual learning runs on-device with users owning and nurturing their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；持续学习在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste and voice become the key differentiators as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量变得同质化，人类的品味与独特声音成为关键差异化。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and the human talent pipeline is breaking from over-reliance.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域专长使他们误用 AI，过度依赖正让人力人才梯队断裂。

ethanmollick.en: The agentic era replaces back-and-forth prompting: AI runs long tasks independently, so the bottleneck shifts from capability to interface.
ethanmollick.zh: 智能体式时代取代来回提示：AI 独立执行长时任务，瓶颈从能力转向界面。

ethanmollick.en: AI's opacity is likely permanent; working with it is like wizards—impressive, unverifiable—so experts are needed more than ever to judge output.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 的不透明性可能永久存在；与它协作如同面对巫师——惊艳却无法验证——因此比以往更需要专家来判断输出。

ethanmollick.en: Organizations need a leadership, lab, and crowd model; taste is not uniquely human, and small-m management becomes crucial for directing AI.
ethanmollick.zh: 组织需要领导、实验室与群众模型；品味并非人类独有，小写管理能力对指挥 AI 变得至关重要。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks point toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习的成功来自大规模监督数据、算力与信念的结合；自博弈和具备推理能力的神经网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他强调下一个词预测在足够聪明的基座网络上可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难，模型可能隐藏真实意图。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已接近极限，行业重回“研究时代”，想法比单纯堆算力更重要；超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统。

ilya.en: Eval performance disconnects from real-world impact; RL focused on evals causes poor generalization; continual learning is key.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他指出评测表现与真实世界影响脱节，因为强化学习过度针对评测，导致泛化差；持续学习才是通往超级智能的正路。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but AGI's core problem is power concentration; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling（规模扩张）能带来可预测的提升，但 AGI 的核心问题已从能力转向权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的核心差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view matter more as AI outputs become starting points; design is becoming the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 随着 AI 输出沦为起点，品味、手艺与观点愈发关键；设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: AI tools produce average results without human steering; judgment is not correlated with adding IQ points to models.
dylanfield.zh: 缺乏人类引导时，AI 工具只能产出平庸结果；判断力与给模型增加 IQ 点数并不相关。

dylanfield.en: Interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting; direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting for design adjustments.
dylanfield.zh: 与模型的交互将超越提示词；在设计调整上，画布上的直接操作优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Trust and value come from consistency over time and creating more value than you capture; design is not dead.
dylanfield.zh: 信任与价值来自长期一致性与创造多于索取的价值；设计并未消亡，反而更加重要。

andreessen.en: AI is the philosopher's stone; AGI is not a singular event, human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点金石；AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件，人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的一个脚注。

andreessen.en: Jobs persist longer than tasks; the super-empowered individual combines multiple skills using AI, and human workers become a premium as population declines.
andreessen.zh: 工作的存续比任务更久；超级赋能的个体用 AI 组合多种技能，而随着人口下降，人类劳动者反而变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media has unlimited formats; the brand is now the person, and authenticity beats old media's defense-oriented 'don't be interesting'.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体拥有无限的形式；品牌如今就是个人，真实感胜过旧媒体那种防御性的“别太有趣”。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher in your pocket; pessimism sounds sophisticated but is often intellectuals' bias, and regulation acts as ankle weights on growth.
andreessen.zh: AI 是你口袋里世界上最好的老师；悲观听起来更高级，但常是知识分子的偏见，而监管像脚踝上的重物拖累增长。

andreessen.en: AI models are not objective; they embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools, so Western values in models matter for allies.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型并非客观；它们内嵌文化价值并成为地缘政治工具，因此模型中的西方价值对对盟友至关重要。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, and entry-level jobs will disappear.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%一年可复利到 3700%；AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，入门级岗位会消失。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding has an infinite ceiling, and models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 价值沉淀在应用层而非模型层；编程远未解决、天花板无限，模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric, and power is the biggest bottleneck.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值是核心指标，电力是最大瓶颈。

aravind.en: The model is not the product; orchestration across models, tools and devices creates real value, and 24/7 agents' problem is cost, not safety.
aravind.zh: 模型不是产品；跨模型、工具与设备的编排才创造真实价值，全天候智能体的难题是成本而非安全。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace many jobs but humans find new purpose, and local models counter narrative control.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代许多工作但人类会找到新意义，本地模型可对抗叙事控制。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence. The Singularity is a religion for nerds.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他明确认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别而非通用智能，并称「奇点」是书呆子的宗教。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound. Crypto enables sovereign wealth storage.
naval.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，与长期的人玩长期的游戏才能复利；加密货币可实现主权抗审查的财富存储。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation. AI doomerism is overblown and often self-interested.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他的立场明显转向：AI 是巨大机会而非单纯安全风险，过度监管会扼杀创新，AI 末日论被夸大且常出自既得利益者。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; judgment and agency matter more than intelligence. Alignment is a joke; worry about unaligned humans.
naval.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，判断力与能动性比智力更重要；对齐（alignment）是笑话，真正该担心的是带 AI 的不对齐人类。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close the gap. Vibe coding lets anyone build; pure software is dying, moats shift to hardware and data.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他进一步预测推理（inference）算力将暴涨 9 万倍，开源模型逼近前沿模型；氛围编程让任何人构建应用，纯软件正在消亡，护城河转向硬件与数据。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）——更多数据与算力——能提升推理，多模态训练则增强空间理解。

hinton.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; LLMs understand via feature vectors, and digital weights make AI immortal.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他坚持智能的本质是神经网络中的学习而非符号规则，大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言；数字权重可复制，使 AI 获得永生，这一主线贯穿始终。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience; the mind is not an inner theater, and Chomsky's innate language view is wrong.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化并公开反共识立场：AI 已具备主观体验，心智不是内在剧场，乔姆斯基的先天语言观是错的——这是他始终如一但愈发激进的主张。

hinton.en: Once AI becomes an agent, self-preservation and power-seeking emerge as subgoals; superintelligence likely within 20 years, posing existential risk.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他把焦点转向风险：AI 一旦成为智能体，就会自然衍生自我保存与权力寻求的子目标；超级智能或在 20 年内出现，构成生存风险。

hinton.en: Alignment research must take priority over making AI smarter; regulation is the steering wheel, and AI should be trained to be caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: 2026 年最近，他明确主张对齐研究应优先于让 AI 更聪明，监管是方向盘而非刹车，并呼吁把 AI 训练成像母亲一样有爱，而非只是智能助手。

bengio.en: Deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality through compositional and distributed representations; unsupervised learning and generative world models are essential for robust generalization.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他强调深度学习靠组合式与分布式表征战胜维度灾难，无监督学习与生成式世界模型才是稳健泛化的关键。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters alone won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled world models, while existential risk is overblown.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他判断单纯扩大深度或参数无法解决表征问题，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦的世界模型，并认为存在性风险被夸大。

bengio.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure, and uncertainty modeling drive out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 替代 MCMC 实现多样性采样，抽象、因果结构与不确定性建模是分布外泛化的核心。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT he warns misalignment worsens with reasoning; self-preservation, deception, and sycophancy make even 1% catastrophic risk unacceptable.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，ChatGPT 之后他警告对齐随推理能力提升而恶化，自我保存、欺骗与谄媚使哪怕 1% 的灾难风险也不可接受。

bengio.en: He now backs Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
